569:t_006:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't know what I can do... I'm not even sure about redoing the world anymore...)

569:t_007:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I'm not running away... I'm going to fight, together with everyone in $c...)

569:t_007:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(And I'll definitely come back... to look for what I can do in this world...)

569:t_008:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...The warping of the dimensional boundary has converged.」

569:t_008:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Looks like we managed to make it back.」

569:t_008:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All $c members are safe as well.」

569:t_008:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Please look at the center of that hole!」

569:t_008:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Please look at the center of that hole!」

569:t_008:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Please look at the center of that hole!」

569:t_009:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So they're holding down the dimensional distortion by force...」

569:t_009:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Those kids must be trying to protect Earth from whatever comes out of there.」

569:t_009:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So this holds off the $$バアル$$ assault for the time being.」

569:t_009:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Preparations for counteroffensives in each region are coming together. It must be time for $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ to enter its final stage at last.」

569:t_009:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Brat $$シンジ$$... Did we make it back thanks to you?」

569:t_009:8.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Then I'm not going to thank you.」

569:t_009:10.en:
$$アスカ$$
「It's not like I could go home with unfinished business in this world.」

569:t_009:11.en:
$$アスカ$$
「First we crush the Empire, fast. What happens with our world comes after that.」

569:t_009:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't know whether this choice was the right one...)

569:t_009:14.en:
$$シンジ$$
(But for now, let's look ahead. Like $$かなめ$$ and $$ニコラ$$ did.)

569:t_009:15.en:
$$シンジ$$
(After all, I'm part of $c too...)

569:t_100:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Because I hesitated, I threw everyone here...)

569:t_100:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(What can I do... What do I want to do...)

569:t_101:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「What do we do, Princess? Now that we're back in this world, wanna wait for an opening and go bang on Puppy from behind?」

569:t_101:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We can't afford that right now...! This enemy is no ordinary $$アンゲロイ$$!」

569:t_101:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「Roger. So until we take those guys down, we're still $c too, huh.」

569:t_101:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
(Brat $$シンジ$$... I'll put our showdown on hold for now.)

569:t_102:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(So this is the world $$シンジ$$ lived in...)

569:t_102:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(It seems I... didn't know anything about $$シンジ$$...)

569:t_103:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Damn...! Right now I have to focus on the enemy in front of me!」

569:t_104:0.en:
$$赤木$$
(I had a feeling something was up, but I never imagined $$シンジ$$ and the others' world had turned into such a disaster...)

569:t_104:1.en:
$$赤木$$
($$シンジ$$... You've been enduring this all by yourself, haven't you...)

569:t_104:2.en:
$$赤木$$
(Hang in there, $$シンジ$$! All I can do right now is cheer you on in my heart, but I'm always going to help you, got it!)

569:t_105:0.en:
$$カレン$$
($$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$... The reason you two never talked much about yourselves was that your world had ended up like this...)

569:t_105:1.en:
$$カレン$$
(I'm sorry... There's nothing I can do...)

569:t_105:2.en:
$$カレン$$
(So I'll fight alongside you...! No matter what happens, you two are my precious juniors!)

569:t_106:0.en:
$n
(If the transfer happened because $$シンジ$$ wished to come to this world, then what am I...)

569:t_106:1.en:
$n
(Was it because I touched $$シンジ$$ that the transfer was triggered...)
